articles.제목: Newcleo, Curio team up for recycled nuclear fuel supply
articles.원문 요약: France-headquartered innovative nuclear energy company Newcleo is to collaborate with US advanced nuclear recycling technologies firm Curio on the supply of recycled used nuclear fuel and transuranic materials for the production of mixed-oxide fuel at Newcleo's planned US fuel manufacturing facility.

articles.제목: NRC extends Project Ike review timetable
articles.원문 요약: The US regulator has pushed the expected completion date for its review of Orano's application for a licence for its proposed centrifuge enrichment facility back to June 2027 after the company asked for more time to respond to the regulator's questions.
